tokens.name: bg-window
tokens.usage: Toolbar, title bar and status bar: the window chrome.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebars, inspector, debug area. Panels are split by `line`, never floated as cards.

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Text and number fields, the packet log, code.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and borderless buttons.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row while its list does not have focus. Text stays `text`.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: The 3D viewport ground. Mid-grey, as in Blender and Unity, so lit geometry and dark geometry both read.

tokens.name: viewport-grid
tokens.usage: Floor grid lines in the viewport.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels, sections and table rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of fields, buttons and segmented controls. 3:1 on bg-panel and bg-field.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-window, bg-panel, bg-field, bg-selected and viewport.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, units, secondary lines, column headers. 4.5:1 on bg-window, bg-panel and bg-field.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Controls and selection: the default button, focused selection, links, the viewport selection outline. As text, on bg-panel and bg-field.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 1px offset. Alias of accent.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Live mode only: the toolbar edge, the status bar fill and the Live segment while real hardware drives the scene.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a live fill.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis: gizmo handle, the X letter of a Vector3 field, X components in JSON. As text, on bg-field.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis (up).

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Streaming and healthy. Always beside a word or a number.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings: unmet capability tier, seq gaps, latency over budget. Always with the warning icon.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the issue banner.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Schema errors, dropped packets, script exceptions. Always with the error icon or a count.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: SF Pro Display, semibold, tight. The same family as the app, so the brand and the tool are one thing.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name on the cover, landing page and demo slides.

styles.name: marketing
styles.sample: Prototype with the devices in your pocket.

groups.name: Studio
groups.note: Sizes follow the macOS type scale. Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Window, sheet and inspector entity titles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section titles in the inspector and sidebars.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Field labels, table cells and column headers in dense panels, as in Figma's properties panel.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Only for JSON, scripts and identifiers you would type. Numbers in fields stay in `sans` with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; between a field and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; field padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between inspector sections' content blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet inset; cover inset.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Marketing rhythm only.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls (macOS regular controls).

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows, sheets, popovers, the cover blocks.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, fields and segmented controls in panels.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Rows in the device list and inspector.

tokens.name: table-row-height
tokens.usage: Rows in the packet log.
